verdict.rationale: Teller documents structured API resources for balances, transactions and identity, and its transactions docs define a fixed set of category values. That category enrichment is something an automated workflow can reason over. However, the evidence never explicitly says responses are JSON, and every OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404, so there is no machine-readable schema an agent could ingest. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI or machine-readable schema, explicit confirmation of the JSON response format, enrichment beyond categorization (such as merchant normalization), and independent hands-on corroboration that responses are agent-consumable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the data comes back agent-consumable — clean structured JSON, documented schemas, and enrichment an automated financial workflow can reason over without heuristic parsing
